content: {"rule":"K-C","applies":"no","applies_why":"The judge text does not state that the witnesses pressed against the link are the pressing side's own chain read together, so it does not show the chain-against-chain collision condition K-C governs.","verdict":"CLEAN","quote":"D5 vs C5 (Isaiah 7:14): UNDERDETERMINED -- [CR2] G answers the 'almah/bethulah and near-fulfillment rows, leaving the sign's sense open.","rule_words":"When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.","room":"none","why":"The judge's stated reason for underdetermination does not indicate verse-by-verse weighing or use of the retired stating-verse test."}
